categories.title: Categories / games
categories.description: Exact category names as shown on Twitch, e.g. Fortnite, Just Chatting, Music, Art. Returns currently live streamers in each.

searchQueries.title: Search queries (optional)
searchQueries.description: Free-text channel search, e.g. music producer, cooking, poker coach. Also finds offline channels.

logins.title: Specific logins (optional)
logins.description: Twitch usernames to look up directly.

minFollowers.title: Min followers (optional)
minFollowers.description: Only streamers with at least this many followers.

maxFollowers.title: Max followers (optional)
maxFollowers.description: Only streamers with at most this many followers. Set 5000-50000 to target micro influencers.

requireEmail.title: Only streamers with a business email
requireEmail.description: Skip streamers whose bio contains no email address.

maxStreamers.title: Max streamers per run
maxStreamers.description: Cap on streamer rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip streamers seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned streamers across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
